name: @refarm.dev/enrichment-provider-ref
description: enrichment:v1 provider as a refarm integration plugin — proves a domain lookup can arrive as a WASM extension (respond routes by method), loaded not imported.

scripts.build:plugin: pnpm run bundle:plugin && jco componentize dist/plugin.bundled.js --wit ../refarm-plugin-wit/wit --world-name refarm-plugin --disable all -o dist/enrichment_provider.wasm && jco transpile dist/enrichment_provider.wasm -o pkg-plugin --name enrichment_provider --no-wasi-shim --instantiation async && node scripts/write-plugin-manifest.mjs
